paper_metadata.title: Comparison of the microstructural and wear resistance for thermal spray coating deposited oxidation and wear resistant AlSiTiCrFeCoNiMo and AlSiTiCrFeNiMo

evidence.quote: The thermal spray technology is commonly used for structural components by building up a protective coating layer on their surfaces. Choos ing a suitable sprayed metal can improve corrosion resistance, [1,2] oxidation resistance, [3–5] wear resistance[6] and/or heat insulation, and thus extend the life of protected components.
In this study, a new alloy design concept was explored to create alloys with excellent combinations of properties for some critical applications such as dies, molds and turbine blades.
